The '''''Journal of Topology''''' is a [[Peer review|peer-reviewed]] [[scientific journal]] which publishes papers of high quality and significance in [[topology]], [[geometry]], and adjacent areas of mathematics. It was established in 2008, when the [[editorial board]] of ''[[Topology (journal)|Topology]]'' resigned due to the increasing costs of [[Elsevier]]'s subscriptions.<ref>{{cite journal|url=https://www.ams.org/notices/200705/comm-toped-web.pdf|last=Jackson|first=Allyn|title=Jumping Ship: Topology Board Resigns|journal=Notices of the American Mathematical Society|date=May 2007|pages=637–639|accessdate=26 February 2012}}</ref> 

The journal is owned and managed by the [[London Mathematical Society]] and produced, distributed, sold and marketed by [[John Wiley & Sons]]. It appears quarterly with articles published individually online prior to appearing in a printed issue.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.lms.ac.uk/publications/jtop|title=Journal of Topology {{!}} London Mathematical Society|website=www.lms.ac.uk|access-date=2019-04-01}}</ref>
<br />

== Abstracting and indexing ==
The journal is abstracted and indexed in [[Mathematical Reviews]], [[Science Citation Index]], and [[Zentralblatt MATH]].
